Gay USA, Vol. XV, Episode No. 19, QPTV Queens New York
1. Lesbian and Gay News: Andy Humm and Ann Northrop discuss recent general events that relate to the LGBT community.
2. AIDS News. Includes MSNBC News footage of President Bill Clinton at Morgan State University discussing AIDS.
COMMERCIAL: Trailer for film "Love! Valour! Compassion!"
3. Interview: Richard Bannin, new Executive Director of Senior Action in a Gay Environment (SAGE) NY, discusses his new position.

4. "Lambda Update": Beatrice Dohrn, Legal Director of Lambda Legal Defense and Education Fund, introduces Jennifer Pizer, Western Regional Office Managing Attorney, discussing a right-wing attempt in Alaska to make lesbians and gays exempt from anti-discrimination laws on religious grounds.
